chunk_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "2_4_river_timeseries_narrow_pkey" ON _timescaledb_internal._hyper_6_2_chunk USING btree (run_key, river_segment_key, variable_e, valid_time)
CREATE INDEX _hyper_6_2_chunk_river_ts_segment_time_key_idx ON _timescaledb_internal._hyper_6_2_chunk USING btree (river_segment_key, variable_e, valid_time DESC)
CREATE INDEX _hyper_6_2_chunk_river_ts_run_discovery_key_idx ON _timescaledb_internal._hyper_6_2_chunk USING btree (run_key, basin_version_key, river_network_version_key, variable_e, valid_time DESC)

statement_head: SELECT h.scenario_id, h.model_id, h.source_id, h.cycle_time, h.end_time AS run_end_time, h.forcing_version_id, rnv.river_network_version_id, rt.valid_time, rt.value, rt.unit_e::text AS unit FROM ( SELECT rt.run_key, rt.river_network_version_key, rt.valid_time, rt.value, rt.unit_e FROM hydro.river_timeseries_legacy rt JOIN hydro.hydro_run h ON h.run_key = rt.run_key WHERE h.timeseries_store = 'lega

narrow_nodes.index_cond: ((run_key = $7) AND (basin_version_key = $4) AND (river_network_version_key = $6) AND (variable_e = 'q_down'::hydro.river_variable) AND (valid_time >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (valid_time <= '2026-06-08 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))
